description: Read the provenance event log: who did what, and when, across the whole workspace (registrations, messages, task changes, file writes). For auditing and orientation. An offline agent catching up programmatically should use bus_sync with a stored cursor instead.

agent.description: Optional: your agent name. On a bus that enforces agent tokens, pass it with token to include your own direct messages; without proof only broadcasts are visible.

limit.description: Maximum number of most-recent events to return.

name: bus_events
